data.why: The repository bundles a curated, openly-licensed MassBank reference library (data/demo/massbank_open.msp.gz) and example query spectra (data/demo/example_queries.mgf) that the dashboard loads by default; a trimmed copy of the example queries is also placed in data/ so the browser agent can exercise the 'upload your own MGF' path with a real, valid file.

goals: Identify an unknown MS/MS spectrum by searching it against the curated MassBank reference library and inspect the ranked candidate list
Compare cosine, modified cosine, and spectral entropy similarity scores to see which measure best discriminates isomers
Inspect an interactive mirror plot of the query spectrum against a ranked hit to visually judge fragment-by-fragment agreement
Search for structural analogues (via modified cosine) when the query compound is deliberately excluded from the library, and judge the proposed analogue's Tanimoto structural similarity
Review the library's composition and filter it by compound name to check coverage
Review benchmark statistics (top-1/3/10 accuracy with confidence intervals, cross-lab and isomer scenarios) to judge how reliable an annotation is in realistic conditions

review.summary: The tree states the tool's purpose well (identify, find analogues when the compound is absent, and judge reliability honestly), uses sensible phases, has nearly all claims backed by real screens, and has six well-cut features. It needs small corrections before filing: one wrong score range, an unstated 50 Da condition on the entropy analogue result, a missing custom-library upload task and feature, and a misleading 'exact matches' label.
